youtube_title: Michigan City's Old Lighthouse: Harriet Colfax kept the light for 43 years
body: In 1861, Harriet Colfax took charge of Michigan City's lighthouse, and she kept it for 43 years, living there with her lifelong companion, Ann Hartwell. Every night of the shipping season she lit the lights after sunset, and after 1871 she also walked a long, raised walkway out the pier to a second light, even when ice coated it. In 1873 she wrote in her log, "A terrible hurricane to-night." She retired in 1904 at about 80 and died the next spring. Her 1858 lighthouse still stands as the Old Lighthouse Museum, open April through October. 🌊 Comment your town, and it could be next! #MichiganCity #LaPorteCounty #Lighthouse #LakeMichigan #Indiana #History #LaPorteAfterDark

In 1873 she wrote in her log: "A terrible hurricane to-night."
She retired in 1904 at about 80 and died the next spring. Her 1858 lighthouse still stands as the Old Lighthouse Museum, open April through October.
